info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Payouts-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Payouts API enables users to access detailed information regarding payouts related to insurance claims. This endpoint allows stakeholders, such as insurance adjusters and claims analysts, to retrieve a comprehensive list of payouts associated with specific claims efficiently. By leveraging this API, users can streamline their claims processing workflows, ensuring timely and accurate disbursement of payouts. Ideal for organizations looking to enhance their claims management systems, this API supports seamless integration with existing tools and platforms.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed payout information for claims. It provides data necessary for understanding the payouts associated with submitted claims, helping you manage financial expectations and reporting.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve payout details related to claims. It expects a JSON object that adheres to the specified schema for handling claims payout operations.
